validations.original_chunk: that s the irony i can t get past. the same people who ll happily use basic gpt models to check for spam or generate routine content are the same ones telling you that ai-driven writing is some kind of moral hazard. it s laughable. i ve spent countless hours creating my own models, making sure the content i share is valuable, factual, and functional. i ve never been one to just throw a prompt into a generator and call it a day. my content whether it s the PowerShell networking scripts or my deep dives into cybersecurity has always been tested, fine-tuned, and thoroughly fact-checked. yet despite my efforts, the broader sentiment on this platform and many others remains one of disdain and fear towards ai. it s as though the moment ai is involved, no matter how carefully or responsibly it s used, the content is automatically dismissed as inferior.
